text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the removal of an on-street accessible parking space located on the north side of Bedford Park Avenue, west of Greer Road. The existing on-street accessible parking space is no longer required by the original applicant.

North York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing designated on-street accessible parking space in effect at all times on the north side of Bedford Park Avenue, between a point 49.6 metres west of Greer Road and a point 5.5 metres further west
